description: The street has a wide, continuous roadway with marked lanes and no visible pedestrian sidewalk in this view; pedestrians would likely need to walk along the road edge. Traffic is separated from the tree-lined verge by a curb/landscaped strip, with trees providing substantial shade on the right and streetlights along the roadway, but there are no clearly visible curb cuts, ramps, or pedestrian crossing facilities. The right side includes landscaped greenery and some parked/side objects near the verge, which could create obstacles for pedestrians.
